Markets.summary: Nike announced a plan to generate an additional $5 billion in revenue by fiscal 2031 under CEO Elliott Hill. The turnaround strategy focuses on prioritizing performance sports in strategic countries to return the company to revenue growth by fiscal 2029.

Markets.title: Sebi lowers margin requirements for agri-derivatives contracts
Markets.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India lowered the initial margin requirements for agricultural derivatives contracts to between 6% and 10%. This one-year change, effective December 1, aligns agricultural commodity standards with those of non-agricultural products like metals.

Markets.title: K Raheja Corp inks joint development agreement for 165-acre township in Mumbai region
Markets.summary: K Raheja Corp has signed a joint development agreement with landowners for a 165-acre township in Panvel within the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The land parcel is valued at approximately Rs 956 crore, and the revenue from the project will be shared between the developer and the landowners.

Markets.title: BlackRock raises its stake in Axis Bank to 5%
Markets.summary: BlackRock has increased its stake in Axis Bank to 5 percent by purchasing additional shares from the open market. This acquisition brings the investment giant's total holdings in the bank to over 155 million shares.

Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine executed a planned missile and drone attack that partially collapsed the strategic Crimean Bridge. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky hailed the operation as an unprecedented strike against the Russian-annexed territory.

Geo-Political.summary: Kyiv launched a seven-stage attack that caused major damage to the Crimean Bridge. The structure is a key symbol of Russia's occupation of Ukraine.

Geo-Political.summary: Nvidia reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday. The positive financial results come amid the dramatic exit of former CEO Jensen Huang, whom the firm stated will not be reinstated.

Geo-Political.title: Thomas Markle charged over child sex abuse material in Philippines
Geo-Political.summary: Thomas Markle has been charged in the Philippines with offenses related to child sexual abuse material. He is currently detained in the United States on an unrelated charge and has previously denied all allegations.

Geo-Political.summary: Moscow targeted bridges in Kyiv with airstrikes, terrifying residents who had to seek shelter. Meanwhile, Ukraine severely damaged a critical bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea.

Data & Insights.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warns that the AI boom could cause widespread job displacement through automation. Alternatively, he notes it may drive faster economic growth or trigger a slowdown if market expectations fail.

Data & Insights.title: Union Budget 2027-28: FICCI seeks graded LTCG taxation,  ₹100 lakh crore in credit for manufacturing growth
Data & Insights.summary: FICCI has recommended restoring the long-term capital gains tax exemption on listed securities while advocating for a calibrated increase in the securities transaction tax. Additionally, the industry body has sought ₹100 lakh crore in credit to drive manufacturing growth in the Union Budget 2027-28.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: What FM's pre-budget stakeholder consultations mean
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is holding pre-budget consultations with various stakeholders over the coming days. The meetings include industry executives, bankers, capital market participants, social sector experts, young people, and retired bureaucrats.

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027: Economists oppose LTCG tax cut as industry seeks abolition; what they told Sitharaman
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of the 2027-28 Union Budget, economists have advised Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to retain the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax on equities. This recommendation directly opposes the industry's demand for the complete abolition of the tax.

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027-28: Govt to invite Gen Z for pre-Budget consultations; Sitharaman meets economists
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has started pre-Budget consultations with economists for the Union Budget 2027-28. The government also plans to gather input from Gen Z, industry leaders, trade unions, and state governments.

Data & Insights.title: Centre hikes windfall tax on diesel, ATF exports; petrol levy unchanged — Check details
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has increased the windfall tax on exports of diesel and Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF). Meanwhile, the export levy on petrol remains unchanged following the previous revision on October 31.

India.title: Azam Khan Gets Relief As Supreme Court Stays Conviction, High Court Grants Interim Bail
India.summary: The Supreme Court stayed the conviction of Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan. He is expected to be released from jail on Wednesday after the High Court granted him interim bail.

India.title: Elderly Couple, Student Killed In Road Accidents In UP: Cops
India.summary: An elderly couple and a student were killed in separate road accidents in Uttar Pradesh. The couple died after a speeding truck hit their motorcycle on National Highway-19.

India.title: "Must End": India Condemns Hormuz Tanker Attack After Indian Goes Missing
India.summary: India has condemned an attack on an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz after an Indian crew member went missing. The Indian Embassy in Oman is closely coordinating with Omani authorities on the ongoing search and rescue operations.
